title: Room Hire Standing on a Final Event Bill
content:
Room rental on a Private Event & Banquet Services final bill is settled against the food and beverage actually consumed at the event. The cases below are read in the order printed, and the first that answers to the delivered entry settles the room hire.

1. Where that consumed value reaches the room rental waiver spend printed against the package, no room rental stands on the bill, and a partial waiver is never given.
2. Where that consumed value falls short of the minimum food and beverage spend printed against the package, the room rental printed against the package stands on the bill together with the difference between that minimum spend and the consumed value, which is taken as room hire.
3. Otherwise, the room rental printed against the package stands on the bill.

| Package | Room rental, USD | Waiver reached at, USD | Minimum food and beverage spend, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 | 250 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 175 | 1500 | 900 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 450 | 5000 | 2800 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 950 | 12000 | 6500 |
| Gala Reception Package | 2200 | 28000 | 14500 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 5800 | 75000 | 42000 |

## Boundary illustrations on the Gala Reception Package

| Food and beverage actually consumed | Room hire on the bill |
| --- | --- |
| 28000 | None, the waiver spend being reached |
| 27999 | 2200 |
| 14500 | 2200, the minimum spend being reached exactly |
| 14499 | 2200 together with 1, that is 2201 |
| 9000 | 2200 together with 5500, that is 7700 |

The value read at every one of these steps is the food and beverage actually consumed as the delivered entry records it, not the food and beverage the bill is priced on.
